title: Dynamic discovery versus explicit servers on a server group

prose.text: Whether a server group lists its servers or discovers them decides which fields it must carry.

prose.label: What the provider refuses.
prose.text: {{tf-servers-only-without-dsd}} {{tf-dsd-off-needs-servers}} Whether the API refuses the same combinations is open {{gap:api-dsd-with-servers}}.
How the Python SDK treats these fields on update is in [[zpa.server-groups.update-payload]].

checks.do: Which mode the group is in by reading dynamicDiscovery, remembering that an absent value is read differently by the API documentation, the help and the Python SDK.
Whether a group with dynamicDiscovery false has servers, since the Terraform provider refuses that combination.
Whether a group with servers has dynamicDiscovery true, which the provider also refuses.
Which servers are attached to a non-discovery group, by looking at the Servers page or the group's servers list.

two-kinds.statement: There are two kinds of server group: one with explicitly defined servers added by hand, and one with Dynamic Server Discovery enabled so that Private Access discovers the servers as users request applications.

quotes: There are two types of server groups you can configure:
You can create a server group and manually add servers you've explicitly defined.
You can create a server group with Dynamic Server Discovery enabled so that Private Access discovers the appropriate servers for your applications as users request them.

dsd-needs-only-empty-group.statement: For Dynamic Server Discovery only an empty server group with the setting enabled is needed.

quotes: For this method, you only need to create an empty server group that has Dynamic Server Discovery enabled.

dsd-discovers-through-dns.statement: Dynamic Server Discovery discovers applications through DNS when an empty server group is defined.

quotes: Dynamically discover applications through DNS when an empty server group is defined with Dynamic Server Discovery.

ui-default-on.statement: In the Admin Console the Dynamic Server Discovery setting is enabled by default on a new server group.

quotes: to discover the appropriate servers for your applications as users request them. By default, this setting is enabled.

explicit-servers-attach-to-non-dsd-group.statement: An explicitly defined server must be added to a server group after it is saved, and the server form lists only server groups that have Dynamic Server Discovery disabled.

quotes: After saving, you must add the server to a server group using one of the following options:
Only server groups that have Dynamic Server Discovery (DSD) disabled are displayed.

tf-dsd-unset-is-false.statement: The Terraform `dynamic_discovery` argument has no default, so leaving it out sends `dynamicDiscovery` as false, and a group without servers then fails the provider's own check.

quotes: Description: "This field controls dynamic discovery of the servers.",
DynamicDiscovery: d.Get("dynamic_discovery").(bool),

tf-dsd-unset-is-false.conditions: Absence claim: the schema block for `dynamic_discovery` carries Type, Optional and Description only, with no Default, read at the pin. The create path then runs the empty-servers check quoted in tf-dsd-off-needs-servers.

python-writes-explicit-servers.statement: The Python SDK writes an explicit server list through the `server_ids` argument of `add_group`, which it sends as `servers: [{id}]`.

quotes: **server_ids (:obj:`list` of :obj:`str`):
dynamic_discovery=False,
body["servers"] = [{"id": group_id} for group_id in body.pop("server_ids")]

dynamic-discovery-default.summary: The OpenAPI document, the help and the Python SDK give different defaults for dynamicDiscovery.

positions.says: The request field defaults to false.

quotes: to discover the appropriate servers for your applications as users request them. By default, this setting is enabled.

positions.says: The Admin Console form has the setting on by default.

quotes: self.dynamic_discovery = config["dynamicDiscovery"] if "dynamicDiscovery" in config else True

positions.says: The Python model treats an absent value as true.

dynamic-discovery-default.impact: A client that omits the field, or a read that does not return it, does not get one consistent mode: the API document says false, the console says true, and the Python SDK rewrites an absent value as true when it builds an update body.

api-dsd-with-servers.title: Whether the ZPA API itself enforces the dynamic discovery and servers rule
api-dsd-with-servers.detail: The refusal of servers with dynamic discovery on, and of no servers with it off, is shown only in the Terraform provider. No captured source says whether a direct API call is refused the same way. Send both combinations to a scratch tenant.
